description: WPT-derived L2 mechanism probe (storage): localStorage key() semantics. The fixture asserts the actual WPT storage_key contract in-page — every in-range index returns a distinct existing key, out-of-range returns null, and updating an existing key's value preserves the enumeration order — then reports the sorted key set. No specific enumeration order is required.
title: localStorage key()/length contract (order-insensitive)
